csharp_space_between_parentheses #

Spacing inside parentheses. ⚠ Recorded as inert — "the oracle returns the file unchanged at control_flow_statements, so this MS-compat spelling reaches nothing" — and that is wrong. Measured at false against control_flow_statements, the oracle writes if ( a > 0 ), while ( … ), for ( … ), foreach ( … ) and catch ( … ), exactly as resharper_space_between_parentheses_of_control_flow_statements does. It is observable and unimplemented, which is a different thing from inert. ⚠ Blocked on the one mechanism the registry does not have: expands propagates a generalized key's value TEXT into the keys it names, so it can only reach targets whose domain — and whose polarity — is its own. Three keys need the same missing piece and none of them is a coverage gap: this one, csharp_space_between_parentheses and csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers.

Typeany combination, comma-separated, of control_flow_statements, expressions, type_casts, false
Defaultfalse
Default known fromnothing beyond the export
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
Languagecsharp
Since0.1
Documented athttps://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/fundamentals/code-analysis/code-style-rule-options
